descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Produse pentru rețele de computere
Who we are We’re a group of infrastructure brands run by one engineering team:
 X-ZoneServers : dedicated servers, VPS and high-bandwidth hosting (10–200 Gbps) in 13 locations across Europe and North America.
 ZeroPing : managed game servers (Minecraft, Palworld, Valheim and more) with one-click setup, mods and settings handled for you. 
 FluxBilling : our own billing and automation platform. Other hosting companies use it to sell and manage VPS, dedicated and game servers.
 We own the whole stack: hardware, network, virtualisation and the billing software on top. When a customer has a problem, nothing is out of reach. You can follow it from the panel down to the hypervisor.
What you’ll do 
Answer tickets and live chat for all brands, in English and Romanian.
Fix common issues yourself: a VPS/bare metal that won’t boot, lost network config, SSH lockouts, DNS and rDNS questions, slow servers, billing and invoice questions.
Walk customers through OS installs, IP and firewall setup, game server setup, and FluxBilling configuration (for hosting companies running our platform).
Read logs and monitoring before you reply. Diagnose first, then answer.
Pass harder cases (network, hardware, abuse, platform bugs) to senior engineers with a clear write-up, then follow through until the customer is helped.
Turn every repeated problem into a knowledge-base article or internal note.
Spot patterns. If five tickets this week say the same thing, tell us.
 What we’re looking for Must have 
Real curiosity about how servers and networks work. Home lab, Linux tinkering, running a game server: all of it counts.
Basic Linux on the command line (SSH, files, services, logs). Windows Server basics help.
An understanding of IP addresses, DNS, ports and firewalls.
Clear, calm, polite writing in English and Romanian .
Patience and care. You’d rather fix the root cause than close the ticket.
Available to train on-site in Bucharest for a few weeks.
 Nice to have 
Experience with KVM/libvirt, Proxmox, Virtualizor or similar.
Hosting control panels or billing systems (WHMCS, Blesta, etc.).
Any ticketing system or support job.
An IT certification or degree. Not required.
 Not required: a degree or a baccalaureate. We hire for skill and attitude, not paperwork.
